name: update_trigger
description: Update an existing trigger owned by the current user. Pass only the fields you want to change; omitted fields are left alone. The same three-part shape applies: `trigger_nl_condition` is the **if** condition, `trigger_fire_message` is what to deliver, `destination` is where (only `null` = Event Log is supported in v0). Use `enabled` to disable/re-enable a trigger without deleting it. Only call after the user has explicitly asked for the update.

trigger_id.description: ID of the trigger to update (e.g. `trg_abc123...`). The trigger must be owned by the current user.

scope_path.description: New scope (wiki-relative file or directory; use `/` or an empty string for the whole wiki). If the scope changes, the YAML moves to match. Omit to keep current.

trigger_nl_condition.description: New **if condition**. Omit to keep current.

trigger_fire_message.description: New **fire message** body delivered on fire. Omit to keep current.

destination.description: New **destination**. Must be `null` in v0. Omit to keep current.

enabled.description: Disable or re-enable the trigger. Omit to keep current.
